# Design review

Read the plan and the existing design system or UI. Follow the key user flow through empty, loading, success, error, and narrow-screen states. Check information hierarchy, accessibility, keyboard operation, contrast, content clarity, and consistency with existing components. Where a visual judgment is subjective, show the evidence and what a stronger design would change.

Do not require a new design system for a local UI change. Update the plan with concrete interface states, component choices, and acceptance checks. If the work has no UI, mark this perspective not applicable and return without opening unrelated design material.
